atomic_facts.fact: Elizabeth Holmes was convicted on four counts of wire fraud and conspiracy in the United States v. Holmes trial.
The jury delivered its verdict on January 3, 2022.
The case was captioned United States v. Elizabeth A. Holmes.
The convictions consisted of one count of conspiracy to commit wire fraud against investors and three counts of wire fraud involving investments totaling more than $140 million.
The jury acquitted Holmes on one count of patient-related conspiracy to commit wire fraud.
The jury acquitted Holmes on three other wire fraud counts.
The jury deadlocked (was unable to reach a verdict) on three investor fraud counts.
One additional charge of wire fraud related to a Theranos patient was dismissed during trial.
The claim that Elizabeth Holmes was acquitted of all charges in January 2022 is false.
Holmes was found guilty on multiple counts in January 2022.
